decisions.rationale: The complete census contains two confirmed completion races and one intentional fire-and-forget boundary; the JavaScript semantic claim is correct, but context still governs enforcement.
The sole real match is deliberate controller registration. The immutable upstream rule identifies compatibility debt rather than a proven defect.
One sampled case is injection-prone, while most matches and the 28 independently found percent-format cases are safe structural assembly. Attacker control is not established structurally.
Explicit bypass APIs and raw SQL are distinct permission-bypassing operation classes. Retain the former at medium-confidence audit and add a separately named raw-SQL audit rule.

The statement-loop claim remains useful but runtime impact varies. Six independently found comprehension reads satisfy the same performance concern and receive a separate claim so syntax and evidence remain precise.
